CHI.head: Not an easy night for Chicago
CHI.body: St. Louis has controlled the play far better over recent games and Chicago has home ice. Chicago’s best way through is a penalty kill that holds up.

STL.head: St. Louis has a lot going for it
STL.body: St. Louis has controlled the play far better over recent games and Chicago has home ice. Chicago can make it interesting if its penalty kill holds up.
